title: Receipts straight into the right set
description: A batch of shots is assembled by expense, with the recognized amounts and dates checked.

blocks.text: Putting a report together means not just photographing the receipts but handing them over as a single set. The review cited here confirms how awkward it is to add shots one at a time; reading the amounts automatically is a separate hypothesis.

quote.text: Works perfect for work and turning photos into PDFs but the main issue when I'm making a pdf I can't do multiple photos from my gallery at once I have to add one at a time. PLEASE FIX THIS!

blocks.text: Start with batch selection, the order and the export of the originals into one document. If the recipient really does need a table of expenses, add the amounts and dates, with a jump to the matching receipt.
What to check with the recipient

Find out the form in which a person submits expenses today: a PDF, separate shots or a table. How useful field recognition is depends on that. A neatly filled table is useless if the report is accepted in a different format.
